fat-transform-state-audit.json.scope: Completed public World API boundaries, successful scene preparation, fixed build/configuration. Not arbitrary direct GpuSim calls or mid-callback capture.

contracts.region: uploaded transform heads and eight-word commands
contracts.producer: GpuSim::upload_fat_transforms zeros the complete two-word-per-capacity-body head table and writes every command of the new batch before flush_params. checked_add advances the command epoch; overflow returns an error. Growth copies old scratch before rebinding.
contracts.consumer: update_fat_bounds is the sole shader command reader, gated by nonzero batch count and unequal per-shape applied epoch. It writes the applied epoch after processing each body command list.
contracts.next_step: All successful ensure_sim paths reach final write_params, which sets fat_commands_count=0. Public positive-duration step then uploads the pending host batch; empty upload leaves count zero. world_step/callback submission uploads current pass LUT. Therefore previous payload cannot be consumed by the next successful public step, even without assuming every previous dispatch covered every shape.

contracts.contract: state_trace captures each ordered command list keyed by verified live body generation/creation ordinal; map iteration is normalized across independent body lists. Public zero-duration step returns without consuming host history.

Capture includes six raw bound words per shape and initialized/applied equality flags plus all current parameter epochs. Bounds epoch starts at 1 and is only copied on allocation. Command epoch starts at 0 and increases with checked_add, never wraps; stored reachable epochs cannot equal a future new epoch. Applied equality is sufficient under these reachable transitions; arbitrary device corruption is outside this representation claim.
